## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The edition is the **canonical Wén yuān gé *Sìkù quánshū* presentation of the *Lièzǐ*** with its two key scholarly apparatuses: Zhāng Zhàn's commentary (which has been integrated into virtually every subsequent *Lièzǐ* edition) and Yīn Jìngshùn's philological *shì wén* (which provides pronunciations and variant-readings for difficult characters). See [KR5c0049](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0049) for comprehensive background on the *Lièzǐ* itself.

**Dating.** Per the project convention: the received *Lièzǐ* is Eastern-Jìn 東晉 c. 300–370 CE (Graham's analysis). The frontmatter gives **300–370** as the composition window. Dynasty 東晉.
